# Hunter

Hunter is an email marketing company specializing in lead generation and data enrichment.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/hunter/.

## Actions

- **Account Information** (read-only): Retrieve information about your hunter account.
- **Company Enrichment** (read-only): Get enrichment information for a company by its domain.
- **Create custom lead attribute**: Create a new custom lead attribute in your account.
- **Create Lead**: Create a new lead.
- **Create Leads List**: Create a new leads list.
- **Delete Custom Attribute**: Delete an existing custom attribute.
- **Delete Lead**: Delete a lead.
- **Delete Leads List**: Delete a leads list by its id.
- **Domain Search**: Search all email addresses for a given domain or company.
- **Email Finder**: Find the most likely email address for a person at a domain or company.
- **Email Verifier**: Verify the deliverability of an email address.
- **Get Custom Attribute**: Retrieve details of a specific custom attribute.
- **Get Lead**: Retrieve details of a specific lead by id.
- **Get Leads List**: Retrieve details of a specific leads list by id.
- **List Custom Attributes**: List all custom lead attributes in your account.
- **List Leads**: List all leads saved in your account with optional filters.
- **List Leads Lists**: List all leads lists in your account.
- **Update Custom Attribute**: Update an existing custom attribute's label.
- **Update Lead**: Update details of an existing lead by id.
- **Update Leads List**: Update the name of a specific leads list.
- **Upsert Lead**: Create or update a lead by email in one call.
